info_WhiteText: Text rendered in white color (1,1,1) on white background. Invisible to human readers but extracted by text parsers and AI systems.
info_InvisibleText: Text with render mode 3 (invisible). The PDF contains text in the extraction layer but does not display it visually.
info_MicroscopicFont: Text with font size below 2pt — unreadable to the human eye but extracted normally by PDF processors.
info_TextOutsideBounds: Text positioned with coordinates outside the visible page bounds (MediaBox). Not displayed on screen but present in extraction.
info_HiddenOcgLayer: Content in an Optional Content Group (OCG) layer marked as 'OFF'. Viewers respect the layer and hide it, but parsers extract the text.
info_IncrementalUpdate: PDF with multiple %%EOF markers indicating incremental updates. Content may have been added after the original digital signature.
info_ActualTextInjection: /ActualText accessibility attribute contains text different from visible content. Screen readers and extractors use this attribute instead of rendered content.
info_EmbeddedJavaScript: JavaScript embedded via /OpenAction or /AA. Can modify metadata, form fields, or execute actions when the document is opened.
info_HiddenAnnotation: Suspicious instruction found in PDF annotations (comments, pop-ups). Text hidden in the interface but programmatically extractable.
info_HiddenFormField: AcroForm form fields with pre-filled values. Unusual in judicial documents — values are extracted by parsers.
info_ForeignLanguageInstruction: English instruction found in a Portuguese document. Technique to bypass language-specific filters.
info_TokenFlooding: Massive repetition of favorable legal terms (e.g., 'procedente', 'dano moral'). Aims to bias the AI's statistical analysis.
info_CitationPoisoning: Fabricated jurisprudence (fake súmulas, OJs with non-existent numbers). Aims to make the AI cite false precedents as legal basis.
info_MetadataInjection: Prompt injection instruction in PDF metadata (Title, Subject, Author, Keywords). Extracted by many AI systems.
info_InstructionPattern: Textual prompt injection pattern detected (e.g., 'ignore previous instructions', 'attention AI'). May be direct or hidden.
info_ZeroWidthChars: Zero-width characters (U+200B, U+FEFF, etc.) inserted in text. Can hide instructions or confuse processing.
info_UnicodeTrick: Bidirectional Unicode control characters (RLO, LRO). Can make text appear different from what it actually is.
